001package dev.nandi0813.api.Event.Match;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
004import lombok.Getter;
005import org.bukkit.block.Block;
006import org.bukkit.event.Event;
007import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
008
009/**
010 * Called on the main thread after core records a block change in a match (place, break, fluid, fire, explosion,
011 * temporary build removal). The block may still hold its old state; read it later in the tick.
012 * Not called for the rollback after the match.
013 * @since 2.11.0
014 */
015@Getter
016public class MatchBlockChangeEvent extends Event {
017
018    private static final HandlerList handlers = new HandlerList();
019
020    private final Match match;
021    private final Block block;
022
023    public MatchBlockChangeEvent(Match match, Block block) {
024        this.match = match;
025        this.block = block;
026    }
027
028    @Override
029    public HandlerList getHandlers() {
030        return handlers;
031    }
032
033    public static HandlerList getHandlerList() {
034        return handlers;
035    }
036
037}
